items.problem: SKILL.md instructs the agent to compile with `winapp build`, a command that does not exist in the shipped winapp CLI; the agent ran it and got 'build was not matched' (exit 1), wasting a turn.
items.evidence: session-log.txt TURN 30-31 (L3855-3886): `winapp build` -> "'build' was not matched", BUILD_EXIT=1 + winapp help dump (verbs: init/restore/update/package/sign/cert/manifest/run/ui — no build). Confirmed by grepping SKILL.md L126/L138/L170.
items.root_cause: The skill names a non-existent winapp verb; winapp is for `run`/launch, compilation is `dotnet build`.
items.change: Replaced the `winapp build` compile instruction with `dotnet build` in all three SKILL.md locations (Step 3 build loop, the Build-command-discipline note, and the final post-validate confirmation), and corrected the stale `winapp build` references in the Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 header comment and MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md L509. A Tier 1/2 change is not applicable: the validator already runs `dotnet build` internally (check 6); the defect is purely the wrong command string the prose tells the agent to type, so the prose is the correct and minimal place to fix it.
items.expected_effect: Agents compile with a real command; no wasted turn on an invalid `winapp build`, and no risk of mis-trusting its exit code.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run, the build log shows `dotnet build` for the compile/confirm step and contains zero `'build' was not matched` / `winapp build` invocations.
